source.evidence: Atomic product pages list all five lengths and per-length tip/waist/tail dimensions and turn radii; they describe Powder Rocker 20/65/15, HRZN 3D Bent, Light Woodcore, Dura Cap Sidewall, directional shape, Resist Edge Park, 1.0 degree base edge and 87 degree side edge. Official weight is 1700 g per ski at 179 cm.
source.limitations: Weight is specified only at 179 cm and is not generalized to other lengths. The page does not provide per-length ski weight. The listed model is flat (ski only), not a binding bundle. Official product page does not print the season; article AA0030952 is cross-mapped to 2026/27 by model-specific retail pages.

seasonEvidence.evidence: Atomic official product page lists AA0030952+ and the exact five sizes, geometries, radii, weight reference, image family and flat ski-only configuration used by this record.
Yodobashi lists article AA0030694 as 25/26 and AA0030952 as 26/27, distinguishing adjacent seasons by article.
Atomic Bent 100 2026/27 listing identifies exact article AA0030952-000-179 and confirms the 179 cm reference geometry.
Model-year listing maps AA0030952 to 2026/2027 and gives the five lengths, geometries, radii and product image.

publicationDecision: Corrected the seed from the incorrectly assigned 2025/26 season to 2026/27 because the seed's geometry and official image map to article AA0030952; 25/26 was article AA0030694. Publish with the season-source boundary retained.
mappingNotes: The listing's single turnRadius field uses the published 172 cm reference length (18 m); all lengths and their respective radii are also preserved in sidecutDimensions.
No numeric skier ability rating or independent performance score was inferred from manufacturer marketing language.
imageRights: The official Atomic image is a source reference; no explicit reuse license was verified.
